# 7 Peaks Dental

> Family-owned dental practice in Bend, Oregon offering comprehensive general, cosmetic, and restorative dental services led by Dr. Chelsea Baraff.

7 Peaks Dental is a patient-focused dental practice serving Central Oregon with a full range of services from preventive care to advanced restorations. The practice emphasizes accessibility, accepting multiple insurance plans and welcoming new patients.
